name: code-rules
description: Enforces your own coding conventions. Rules live in the project's .code-rules/ folder; a hook blocks source edits until the applicable ones have been read.

interface.shortDescription: Make the agent write code your way.
interface.longDescription: Your conventions as checkable rule files. Rules live in the project's .code-rules/ folder, seeded from a catalog and scoped to the languages the repo actually uses. Run the installer once and a lifecycle hook blocks source edits until the applicable rules have been read.
defaultPrompt: Set up code-rules for this project.
Add a rule that constants are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE at the top of the file.
Show me which code rules are active here.
Install the code-rules enforcement hook for Codex.
